Write your own stop, wait, retry and hook strategies

Source: R/retry_after.R, R/retry_before.R, R/retry_retry.R, and 3 more
extending_retry.Rd

retry() is built from five kinds of strategy. Each has an abstract base class and a generic function, both exported, so you can add your own the same way the built-in ones are written with S7:

Usage

after_sleep_base()

after_sleep_fn(class, state, ...)

before_sleep_base()

before_sleep_fn(class, state, ...)

retry_base()

retry_fn(class, outcome, ...)

wait_base()

wait_fn(class, attempt, prev_wait = NULL, ...)

stop_base()

stop_fn(class, state, ...)

Arguments

class

A strategy object. Methods are dispatched on this argument.

state, outcome, attempt, prev_wait

Described above.

...

Passed to methods.

Value

stop_fn() and retry_fn() return a single TRUE or FALSE, wait_fn() returns a number of seconds, and the hook generics return nothing useful.

Details

retry() argumentBase classGenericThe method returns
stopstop_basestop_fn(class, state)TRUE to give up
waitwait_basewait_fn(class, attempt, prev_wait)seconds to sleep
retryretry_baseretry_fn(class, outcome)TRUE to try again
before_sleepbefore_sleep_basebefore_sleep_fn(class, state)nothing
after_sleepafter_sleep_baseafter_sleep_fn(class, state)nothing

To add a strategy, make a class that inherits from the base class, then register a method for the generic with S7::method<-(). Create the object with new_object() on an instance of the base class, as the built-in strategies do. Load S7 with library(S7) to get new_class(), new_object() and method<-.

Strategies of the same kind compose with the built-in ones. A new wait works in wait_chain() and with +, and a new stop works in stop_any() and stop_all().

If you register methods from another package, call S7::methods_register() in its .onLoad().

Arguments passed to methods

  • state, for stop_fn(), before_sleep_fn() and after_sleep_fn(), is a list describing the attempt that just failed: attempt (1-based), wait (seconds retry() is about to sleep), elapsed (seconds since the first attempt), error (the condition caught, or NULL if retry_if_result() rejected a returned value) and value (the value returned, or NULL if the call errored).

  • attempt and prev_wait, for wait_fn(), are the 1-based attempt number and the previous sleep in seconds (NULL on the first retry).

  • outcome, for retry_fn(), is list(value, error) for the attempt that just finished. error is NULL when the call returned normally, and value is NULL when it errored.

Examples

library(S7)

# Wait `step` seconds longer after each failure
wait_linear := new_class(
  parent = wait_base,
  properties = list(step = new_property(class_numeric, default = 1))
)

method(wait_fn, wait_linear) <- function(class, attempt, prev_wait = NULL, ...) {
  class@step * attempt
}

f <- retry(
  stop = stop_after_attempt(3),
  wait = wait_linear(0.01) + wait_fixed(0.01)
) %@% function() stop("flaky")
try(f(), silent = TRUE)
